typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Importtable_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		REQUEST_NUMBER as string,
		CHANGE_TASK_NUMBER as string,
		TASK_PRIORITY_DESCRIPTION as string,
		TASK_CLOSED_AT as timestamp,
		TASK_CLOSED_BY as string,
		CI_ITEM_NAME as string,
		CI_ITEM_GUID as string,
		START_DATE as timestamp,
		END_DATE as timestamp,
		ASSIGNMENT_GROUP_NAME as string,
		ASSIGNED_TO_NAME as string,
		CHANGE_TASK_TYPE as string,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as timestamp,
		SUB_TYPE_CODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ORACLESOURCEQuery
ORACLESOURCEQuery derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> Addimportdatecolumn
Addimportdatecolumn sink(input(
		ci_item_name as string,
		ci_item_guid as string,
		end_date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		task_closed_at as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		importdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		task_priority_description as string,
		todsh_business_effective_date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		assignment_group_name as string,
		request_number as string,
		sub_type_code as string,
		change_task_number as string,
		change_task_type as string,
		assigned_to_name as string,
		task_closed_by as string,
		start_date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ci_item_name = CI_ITEM_NAME,
		ci_item_guid = CI_ITEM_GUID,
		end_date = END_DATE,
		task_closed_at = TASK_CLOSED_AT,
		importdate = ImportDate,
		task_priority_description = TASK_PRIORITY_DESCRIPTION,
		todsh_business_effective_date = TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE,
		assignment_group_name = ASSIGNMENT_GROUP_NAME,
		request_number = REQUEST_NUMBER,
		sub_type_code = SUB_TYPE_CODE,
		change_task_number = CHANGE_TASK_NUMBER,
		change_task_type = CHANGE_TASK_TYPE,
		assigned_to_name = ASSIGNED_TO_NAME,
		task_closed_by = TASK_CLOSED_BY,
		start_date = START_DATE),
	partitionFileNames:[($Importtable_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Importtable
